rows.grounds: numeral base of compound indicating quantity
locative plural of thousand, qualified by preceding numeral
compound of womb and diagram in locative plural
past passive participle describing those afflicted

items.question: Where are beings subjected to torment according to this teaching?
premises: The quantity specified is eighty-four thousand.
Beings are described as tormented there.
items.inference: Beings suffer torment within the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The specific subjects tormented are implied from prior context rather than named in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
